claims.text: The conceptual model in Figure 2 was developed through a thematic analysis that included six phases, which helped identify and categorize themes related to recycling intention.
The model was enriched by data collected from participants, emphasizing social influence and gamification elements that enhance recycling intention.
The authors suggested that the model could be tested using quantitative methods to further validate its effectiveness.
